item.title: Ironic-image: coreos rootfs and ignition config always served over plaintext http
item.description: A flaw was found in ironic-image. The scripts responsible for constructing kernel parameters for CoreOS root file system (rootfs) and Ignition configuration URLs use a hardcoded http:// scheme. This bypasses the intended Transport Layer Security (TLS) protection, even when TLS is enabled for the iPXE boot chain. An attacker on the local network segment can exploit this vulnerability by performing Address Resolution…

item.title: Maestro: grpc server authentication defaults to 'mock' (allow-all authorizer)
item.description: A flaw was found in maestro. A remote attacker could exploit a misconfiguration in the gRPC server where authentication defaults to a 'mock' mode. This default setting bypasses all authentication and authorization, allowing an unauthorized attacker to write resource bundles. Consequently, this could lead to arbitrary code execution on managed clusters.

item.title: NocoDB: Shared View Row Filter Bypass via Row-Scoped Public APIs
item.description: NocoDB is software for building databases as spreadsheets. Prior to 2026.08.0, the row-scoped endpoints of a public shared view check whether a target record exists by primary key without applying the view's row filter, while the view's list and count endpoints do apply it. A recipient of a shared-view link, including its password where one is configured, can list the linked records of a filtered-out record and…

item.title: XBackBone through 3.8.2 Missing Authorization via Upload Vanity Endpoint
item.description: XBackBone through 3.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to change other users' upload share codes via the POST /upload/{id}/vanity route. Attackers can supply sequential upload ids to MediaController::createVanity() to break existing share links and hijack the freed codes with their own uploads.

item.title: WPExperts New User Approve Plugin REST API class-users-api.php update user role authorization

Impacted is the function update user role of the file includes/end-points/class-users-api.php of the component REST API. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about…

item.title: Libvirt: negative g new0 length can lead to unbounded memory allocation
item.description: A flaw was found in the RPC library APIs of libvirt. The RPC server deserialization code allocates memory for arrays before the non-negative length check is performed by the C API entry points. Passing a negative length to the g new0 function results in a crash due to the negative length being treated as a huge positive number. This flaw allows a local, unprivileged user to perform a denial of service attack by…

item.title: Systemd-resolved: unsigned name response in signed zone is not refused when dnssec=yes
item.description: A vulnerability was found in systemd-resolved. This issue may allow systemd-resolved to accept records of DNSSEC-signed domains even when they have no signature, allowing man-in-the-middles (or the upstream DNS resolver) to manipulate records.

Attackers can specify a handle containing an IPv4/IPv6…

item.title: gdm3: Local privilege escalation via user-controlled PAM environment variables inherited by the root reauthentication worker
item.description: In gdm3 before 51.2, an improper privilege management vulnerability allows an unprivileged local attacker with an active GDM graphical session to execute arbitrary code as root by supplying a malicious environment variable during session reauthentication.

item.title: soapbar: verify envelope bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass)

There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify envelope bsp()…

item.title: github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp permits denial of service through a malformed IPv4 payload length
item.description: In github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/nclient4, BroadcastRawUDPConn.ReadFrom does not validate that the IPv4 payload length is sufficient to hold a UDP header before calculating the DHCP payload length. A frame with an IPv4 total-length field specifying fewer than eight payload bytes results in a negative DHCP length, causing a panic in buf.Consume due to a negative slice bound.

item.title: etcd: CRL enforcement bypass on gRPC listener when --listen-client-http-urls is configured
item.description: Impact What kind of vulnerability is it? Who is impacted? When etcd is configured with --listen-client-http-urls to split the HTTP and gRPC client endpoints onto separate listeners, the --client-crl-file Certificate Revocation List is not enforced on the gRPC listener. A client presenting a revoked certificate is correctly rejected by the HTTP endpoint but continues to authenticate successfully over gRPC. Patches…
